name: AI Merch
tagline: Field app for in-store retail analytics: reps shoot the shelves, AI returns the data
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team for Ai Merch Corp

scenes.title: Shelf intelligence for US retail
scenes.body: AI Merch turns store visits into shelf data for distributors, manufacturers and retailers.

scenes.title: Closest store first
scenes.body: The app reads GPS and puts the nearest store on top with its distance; the full list is searchable.

scenes.title: A guided store visit
scenes.body: Pick Before/After or Survey, shoot cooler doors, shelves and POS displays, then finish the location.

scenes.title: Shelf photos in, shelf data out
scenes.body: Photos queue for background upload; the AI reports SKUs, facings, shelves and empty space for each.

scenes.title: Every visit on record
scenes.body: History lists visited stores by day, with a date-range filter and an item count for each stop.
